links.outcome: Hallucinations in chatbot interpretation of laboratory reports, rated by three medical reviewers
links.effect: Zero hallucinations reported across 30 laboratory reports from two Italian laboratories, using a closed-box setup without external data access.
links.quote: Significantly, the Claude model showed zero hallucinations.

unlisted_practices: Closed-box training of a chatbot restricted to laboratory data interpretation without diagnosis, using domain-specific prompts

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of a Claude-based chatbot (evaluated by 3 independent medical reviewers) on 30 real laboratory reports for patient-facing interpretation without testing a specific comparative deployment practice.
